frontier_alignment.policy: Retired 2026-08-27 with `dev/davis-kahan-1970-frontier.json` and `scripts/check_davis_kahan_frontier.py`.  The frontier graph was the campaign-era map of remaining Davis--Kahan proof obligations; with `DavisKahan/Frontier/` gone and the 29-result inventory and source census carrying certification, it no longer represented anything.  The `frontier_nodes` field on each node below is kept as a historical record of which obligation a node was opened against; it no longer resolves against a live manifest and nothing checks it.

notes: Promoted polar decomposition and nonacute Section 3 declarations are intentionally absent from this hidden-foundation manifest; their canonical owners are DavisKahan/Geometry/Polar modules.

PROMOTED AND REMOVED 2026-08-27: the nine Ky Fan / real-descent Sylvester nodes (kyfan-seminorm, kyfan-bochner, kyfan-unitary-invariance, complex-separated-sylvester-kyfan, complexify-sylvester, complexify-spectrum, complexify-separation, real-separated-sylvester-kyfan, real-separated-sylvester) are no longer hidden foundations. The reusable Ky Fan machinery is ForTauCeti/Analysis/OperatorIdeal/ApproximationNumber/KyFanBochner.lean (ContinuousLinearMap.kyFanGauge_integral_le, continuous_kyFanGauge, kyFanGauge_unitary_comp_comp); the arbitrary-Hilbert complex and real pi/2 finite-Ky-Fan Sylvester theorems and the ideal-gauge corollary are DavisKahan/InfiniteDimensional/Sylvester/GeneralSeparationKyFan.lean (TauCeti.DavisKahanExt.kyFan_sylvester_le_of_generalSeparation{,_real} and idealGauge_sylvester_le_of_generalSeparation_real); the complexification of full-space spectral separation is TauCeti.DavisKahan.Foundation.RealComplexification.spectraSeparated_top_complexify in DavisKahan/SpectralTheory/Complexification/Spectrum.lean. The invertibility and real-spectrum transports were duplicates of the stable isUnit_complexify_iff / realSpectrum_complexify in that same module and were deleted rather than promoted. The two source files are gone and were not replaced by forwarding modules.

2026-08-27: the four `SpectralMultiplicityFoundation` / `CompactPositiveListFoundation` interface and bridge nodes were removed with their module.  Both interfaces were superseded by actual theorems -- `TauCeti.sameSpectralMultiplicity_iff_operatorUnitaryEquiv` and `TauCeti.exists_linearIsometryEquiv_intertwining_of_approximationNumber_eq` -- and neither structure had a consumer outside its own file.

2026-08-27: the eleven MathAhead circle-contour nodes were removed with `DavisKahan/MathAhead/` and `DavisKahan/Experimental/MathAhead/`.  That route is superseded by `DavisKahan/SpectralTheory/CircleContour.lean` (circle path, contour, winding law, separating contour, spectral margin) together with the continuation witness `TauCeti.DavisKahanExt.spectralContinuationWitness_of_circle` in `DavisKahan/InfiniteDimensional/SinTheta/Continuation/CircleWitness.lean`, which builds the witness the MathAhead `RealizedCircleContinuationData` bridge was designed to produce.
